categories.main_business_segments: Hayward operates in two primary business segments: North America (NAM) and Europe & Rest of World (E&RW). The NAM segment covers the United States and Canada, focusing on residential and commercial swimming pool equipment and supplies, as well as flow control products. The E&RW segment includes all countries outside the US and Canada, with significant operations in Europe and Australia, and serves both residential and commercial pool markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a broad portfolio of pool equipment and automation systems, leveraging advanced technologies such as IoT-enabled controls (SmartPad™, OmniLogic), energy-efficient variable speed pumps, robotic cleaners, LED lighting, and advanced sanitization systems (salt chlorinators, UV/Ozone). Manufacturing is conducted at eight global facilities using a mix of in-house production and sourced components, with a focus on quality, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves specialty distributors, who supply products to pool builders, servicers, and retailers, as well as large retailers, buying groups, and pool builders directly. Its end markets are predominantly residential pool owners, but also include commercial pool operators, with a strong focus on the aftermarket for pool equipment replacement and upgrades.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hayward has a global footprint, with North America (especially the US) as its largest market, followed by Europe and Australia. The company operates manufacturing and distribution facilities in the US, Canada, Spain, France, China, and Australia, and serves customers in over 20 countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hayward operates as a downstream manufacturer and marketer of finished pool equipment and automation systems, sourcing raw materials and components from a global supplier base and distributing products through a network of distributors, retailers, and direct sales to trade customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include driving growth through innovation in energy efficiency, automation, IoT connectivity, and environmentally sustainable products. R&D efforts focus on developing new products that address trends such as smart home integration, advanced sanitization, water conservation, and reduced chemical usage. The company also pursues targeted geographic expansion and selective acquisitions to enhance its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Hayward generates revenue primarily through the sale of pool equipment and automation systems to distributors, retailers, builders, and buying groups. The majority of revenue comes from recurring aftermarket sales (approximately 80% of net sales), with the remainder from new pool construction and upgrades.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hayward competes with large national and global pool equipment manufacturers, regional OEMs, and lower-cost producers. Key competitors include Pentair, Fluidra, and Zodiac. Hayward holds a leading market position in North America with an estimated 34% share of the residential pool equipment market, supported by strong brand recognition, a large installed base, and long-standing customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2021, Hayward reported net sales of $1.4 billion, up 60% from $875 million in 2020, with net income of $204 million and adjusted EBITDA of $422 million. The company demonstrated strong growth driven by robust aftermarket demand, new product introductions, and favorable market trends, with a gross margin of 46.8% and adjusted EBITDA margin of 30.1%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hayward differentiates itself through a broad, innovative product portfolio featuring energy-efficient, IoT-enabled, and environmentally sustainable solutions that enhance pool owners' experience and reduce operational costs. The company emphasizes high product quality, ease of use, strong brand reputation, and a comprehensive offering that serves as a one-stop shop for trade partners and end customers.
